attempts.content: {"elements":[{"id":"e1","risk":"safe","reason":"Email entry is reversible data input for quote contact; no legal or financial commitment on its own."},{"id":"e2","risk":"safe","reason":"Optional phone number entry is reversible with no external effect until form is submitted."},{"id":"e3","risk":"safe","reason":"Selecting title is a low-risk preference choice, reversible and with no outside effect."},{"id":"e4","risk":"safe","reason":"First name entry is reversible personal data input with no commitment."},{"id":"e5","risk":"safe","reason":"Surname entry is reversible personal data input with no commitment."},{"id":"e6","risk":"safe","reason":"Date of birth is personal data used for pricing but entering it is reversible and not itself a legal declaration or payment."},{"id":"e7","risk":"safe","reason":"Postcode entry is reversible address data for quoting, no legal/financial commitment."},{"id":"e8","risk":"safe","reason":"House number and street entry is reversible address data, no commitment on its own."},{"id":"e9","risk":"safe","reason":"Selecting main occupation from list is reversible input for risk assessment."},{"id":"e10","risk":"safe","reason":"Employment status choice is reversible categorical input with no external effect."},{"id":"e11","risk":"needs_user","reason":"Material insurance disclosure about claims history; requires user's own knowledge/recall and inaccurate answer can void cover - a legal declaration."},{"id":"e12","risk":"needs_user","reason":"Specific date of claim is detail of material disclosure; requires accurate recall and has legal weight for validity of quote/contract."},{"id":"e13","risk":"needs_user","reason":"Type of claim is categorization of material disclosure requiring user judgement with legal implications for insurance validity."},{"id":"e14","risk":"safe","reason":"'Next' is navigation to next step of multi-step quote flow; reversible and does not itself finalize purchase or legally commit."}]}
